test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who leaves his/her own country to live in another country permanently
solution:
The correct answer is __**Emigrant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Emigrant **means a individual who leaves their own nation in order to settle forever in another.
 
• *Example *: Many **Emigrants **are homeless in UK.
 
• **Synonyms **for word Emigrant are Migrant, drifter.
 
• **Antonym **for word Emigrant are Immigrant , nationalist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The word **Vagabond **means a individual who meanders from place to place without a home or job.

*Example *: He was living a life of **vagabond**.

 
• The word **Mercenary **means a proficient warrior enlisted to serve in a foreign army.

*Example *: He intended to seize power with the help of mercenaries.

 
• The word **Immigrant **means a person who moves to another country to live permanently.

*Example *: "He is a recent German **immigrant **to the United States."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• The word immigrant is used when talking about the country moved to. Emigrant is used when talking about the country moved from (प्रवासी शब्द का उपयोग तब किया जाता है जब देश के बारे में बात की जाती है। देश से स्थानांतरित होने के बारे में बात करते समय उत्प्रवासी का उपयोग किया जाता है । जब वे अपने मूल देश को छोड़ते हैं तो कोई उत्प्रवासी होता है और जब वे अपने नए देश में आते हैं तो अप्रवासी होते हैं।)
